text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees focus on more important work. Instead of replacing people, AI often supports human-AI collaboration, where workers and machines solve problems together. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, so workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI can make workplaces more efficient, but people must adapt to the changes it brings.
